high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article discussing the concept of panpsychism, which is a philosophical view that attributes mental properties to all things. The text at the top mentions IIT's prediction about the mental being more widespread than traditionally assumed, aligning with panpsychism. Below the text, there is a section titled "Panpsychist views," which elaborates on the belief that soul (psyche) is ubiquitous, present not only in animals and plants but also in the fundamental constituents of matter such as atoms, fields, strings, etc.
